subdomain.title: Subdomain
subdomain.description: The router console, behind the login below. Other I2P routers reach this router directly on the same IPv6 address.

yolab_token.title: YoLab token
yolab_token.description: Leave it as it is to use this box's YoLab account.

auth_users.title: Console logins
auth_users.description: The console controls the whole router, so it is only reachable with one of these.

bandwidth_kbps.title: Bandwidth limit (KB/s)
bandwidth_kbps.description: The most the router sends and receives per second, in each direction. Set it below your upload speed.

share_percent.title: Share for other people (%)
share_percent.description: How much of that bandwidth carries other people's traffic. More sharing makes the network faster and your own traffic harder to single out.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Java heap for the router. A router sharing a lot of bandwidth carries more tunnels and needs more.
